title: At the burger place
scene: After the cinema Max wants fast food, so they go to a burger place with a drive-through. Max orders a burger with ketchup and mayonnaise and a milkshake, Anna takes a sundae, and Max's older cousin orders a cold lager.

old_story: After the cinema, Max wants [[fast food]]. They walk to a small place near the park. Cars wait in line at the [[drive-through]]. But Anna, Max, and his cousin Ihor go inside. Max orders a [[burger]] with [[ketchup]] and [[mayonnaise]]. He also gets a chocolate [[milkshake]]. Anna takes a small [[sundae]]. Ihor is older, so he orders a cold [[lager]]. They eat and talk about the movie. Max has sauce on his nose, and they laugh.

title: Breakfast at home
scene: Anna's mama makes a big Sunday breakfast. Bread goes into the toaster for toast with jam, there are pancakes with syrup, bacon and an omelet, and Taras eats only yogurt and half a grapefruit.

old_story: On Sunday morning, Anna's mama made a big breakfast. She put bread in the [[toaster]]. Soon there was hot [[toast]] with [[jam]] on the table. Next came [[pancakes|pancake]] with sweet [[syrup]]. Dad cooked [[bacon]] and a cheese [[omelet]]. Anna ate everything and felt very happy. Only her brother Taras was on a diet. He ate just [[yogurt]] and half a [[grapefruit]]. But ten minutes later, his plate was full!

title: At the supermarket
scene: Anna and Max shop at the supermarket for a dinner with friends. They buy a kilo of tomatoes, two liters of milk, broccoli, an avocado, citrus fruit, a mango, kiwis and tangerines, and cheddar, salami and crackers.

old_story: Anna and Max go to the [[supermarket]]. Friends come for dinner tonight. First, they take a [[kilo]] of tomatoes. Then they get two [[liters|liter]] of milk. Max puts [[broccoli]] and an [[avocado]] in the cart. They also take a sweet [[mango]] and four [[kiwis|kiwi]]. Anna loves [[citrus]] fruit, so she adds [[tangerines|tangerine]]. For snacks, they get [[cheddar]], [[salami]], and [[crackers|cracker]]. At the checkout, Max looks at the bill. It is a big dinner!

title: Baking a birthday cake
scene: Anna and her mama bake for Grandma's birthday: they weigh the ingredients in grams, use honey as a substitute for sugar, mix in cinnamon and vanilla extract with the mixer and set the timer. They make cupcakes with icing, a cheesecake with gelatin, a red velvet cake, brownies, an apple tart and chocolate fudge.

old_story: Anna and her mom bake for Grandma's birthday. First they put all the [[ingredients|ingredient]] on the table. Anna weighs two hundred [[grams|gram]] of flour. They have no sugar, so honey is their [[substitute]]. Mom adds [[cinnamon]] and a spoon of vanilla [[extract]]. Anna turns on the [[mixer]], and Mom sets the [[timer]]. Soon twelve [[cupcakes|cupcake]] come out of the oven. Anna puts pink [[icing]] on each one. Then they make a [[cheesecake]] and a tray of [[brownies|brownie]]. Mom bakes an apple [[tart]], and Anna makes chocolate [[fudge]] with [[pecans|pecan]]. Last, they make Grandma's favorite [[red velvet]] cake. In the evening, Grandma tries everything and smiles.

title: A barbecue at the dacha
scene: On Saturday Anna's family has a barbecue at the dacha. Dad connects the propane and checks the regulator, then cooks hamburgers, hot dogs and roast beef on the grill; everyone has a big appetite, and the kids drink lemonade and roast marshmallows.

old_story: On Saturday Anna's family has a [[barbecue]] at the dacha. Dad connects the [[propane]] tank carefully. He checks the [[regulator]] twice. Then he cooks [[hamburgers|hamburger]] and [[hot dogs|hot dog]] for everyone. Later he puts a big piece of [[roast beef]] on the [[grill]]. After a day in the garden, everyone has a huge [[appetite]]. The kids drink cold [[lemonade]] in the shade. In the evening they roast [[marshmallows|marshmallow]] over the fire. Nobody wants to go back to the city.
